title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-001
doc_notes: This document is an administrative order form and correspondence from the FAA regarding the availability of records for the JAL Flight 1628 sighting; it contains references to encounter reports but does not detail the encounter itself.

encounters.summary: Japan Airlines Flight 1628 crew reported an unidentified traffic sighting over Alaska involving radar data and visual observations.
encounters.quote: unidentified traffic sighting by the flight crew of Japan Airlines flight 1628
